answer: Time-separated checkpoints raise Sybil cost. Each applicant locks 0.77 POA for five epochs and visits three assigned kiosks on a public transit bridge, all inside one 26-hour comet window, at least seven hours apart. At bond time they seal a 36-word fable; each kiosk issues a 12-step proof seeded by kiosk id plus that hash, so one story cannot cover two faces. A missed kiosk costs 0.028 POA. Auditors replay the proofs on the live tip. Reused fable stems or two visits under seven hours slash 45 percent of both bonds and bar that ticket from the next comet window.
